commonContract: May engage every eligible close-range terminal threat authorized by the PDS family rules, including missile flights and boarding craft.
Uses established terminal-defense timing and reaction accounting.
Sub-family identity does not silently alter target eligibility.
notes: Checkpoint 53 keeps all three PDS sub-families available from TL1 and preserves the Checkpoint 51/52 tactical accuracy and Reaction Capacity candidates.
AMM uses 1 Tactical Power of readiness at both TL1 and TL2, matching Kinetic PDS readiness cost; Energy PDS remains 2 TP.
AMM ammunition is held at 25 rounds at both TL1 and TL2 for the current campaign-endurance baseline; do not tune it to force single-fight depletion.

profiles.note: Baseline gun CIWS: cheapest readiness and deep ammunition, lowest candidate accuracy.
Early directed-energy defense: no conventional ammunition, higher readiness power, modest accuracy.
Early interceptor battery: best candidate accuracy, scarce ammunition, still deliberately modest.
Accuracy and ammunition efficiency improve; Reaction Capacity remains one.
Accuracy improves while high readiness power remains the principal tradeoff.
Accuracy improves at TL2 while readiness remains 1 TP and ammunition is held at 25 rounds for the current endurance baseline.

ammunitionSensitivityCandidates.policy: Hold AMM ammunition at 25 rounds at both TL1 and TL2 for Checkpoint 53. Judge the reserve across repeated engagements; revisit quantity or accuracy only if later campaign/tactical evidence warrants it.
